title: Overrun
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Summer. The opposite. The town full past full. One daily.

panels.composition: Main street, August. Cars on every inch. Roller bags. Every lockbox open. Strangers in the road where Wood stood in April.

image.prompt: a small coastal main street in August jammed with cars and tourists with roller bags, every door's lockbox hanging open, a man and a three-legged dog at the very edge of the frame, razor-sharp ink

panels.composition: Gully's. A line down the dock. GULLY, older, pulling shots with both hands. No basket on the counter — no room.

image.prompt: a line of tourists stretching down a wooden dock to a bait-and-espresso shack, a stocky man inside working two espresso group heads at once

panels.composition: Wood at the end stool. Someone else on it. He's standing. The pup between his feet.

image.prompt: a man standing beside a shop stool that a tourist now occupies, a three-legged dog between his feet, the counter crowded

panels.composition: The beach. The drift log. Somebody's towel on it. Wood and the pup walking past it, on.
props: drift log with a stranger's towel

image.prompt: a man and a three-legged dog walking past a bleached drift log with a stranger's beach towel draped over it on a crowded beach, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: The stool taken. A towel on the log.
